title: Client notes and the activity timeline

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Every client page in the ConstructHUB CRM keeps private notes and an activity timeline.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Open a client. We'll use Caleb and Nora Hadley.

steps.caption: Notes
steps.narration: Scroll down to Notes. These are for your team. The client never sees them.

steps.caption: Type a note
steps.narration: Type anything the crew should remember.
steps.value: Park on the street. Small dog in the yard.

steps.caption: Saved with name and time
steps.narration: The note is saved with your name and the time.

steps.caption: Edit or Delete
steps.narration: Use Edit or Delete to change it later.

steps.caption: Activity
steps.narration: Just above Notes is Activity. You don't write this one. The CRM keeps it for you.

steps.caption: Newest first
steps.narration: It lists what has happened with this client, newest first. Here, a payment by check.

steps.caption: A message from the client
steps.narration: Here the client sent a message from their portal,

steps.caption: A reply from the team
steps.narration: and here someone on your team replied.

steps.caption: Menu: Clients
steps.narration: You'll find both on any client's page, under Clients in the menu.

youtube.title: How to use client notes and the activity timeline | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of Notes and Activity on a client's page in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will add a private note for your team, and read the timeline the CRM keeps of what has happened with that client.
